00065 void MulAddUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00066 {
00067     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00068     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00069     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00070     float* mulSamples = inputs[Mul].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00071     float* addSamples = inputs[Add].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00072     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00073     {
00074         *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * *mulSamples++ + *addSamples++;
00075     }

00079 void MulAddUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00080 {
00081     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00082     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00083     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00084     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00085     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00086     float* mulSamples = inputs[Mul].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00087     float* addSamples = inputs[Add].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00088     
00089     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00090     
00091     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00092     {
00093         float nextValue = value;
00094         
00095         if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00096         {
00097             nextValue = *inputSamples * *mulSamples + *addSamples;
00098         }
00099         
00100         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00101         
00102         blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00103         inputSamples        += numKrSamples;
00104         mulSamples          += numKrSamples;
00105         addSamples          += numKrSamples;
00106         
00107         if(value == nextValue)
00108         {
00109             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00110             {
00111                 *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00112                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00113                 --numKrSamples;
00114             }
00115         }
00116         else
00117         {
00118             float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00119             
00120             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00121             {
00122                 *outputSamples++ = value;
00123                 value += valueSlope;
00124                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00125                 --numKrSamples;
00126             }
00127             
00128             value = nextValue;
00129         }
00130     }
00131 }

00133 MulAdd::MulAdd(UGen const& input, UGen const& mul, UGen const& add) throw()
00134 {   
00135     UGen inputs[] = { input, mul, add };
00136     const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00137     
00138     ugen_assert(numInputChannels > 0);
00139     
00140     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00141     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00142     {
00143         internalUGens[i] = new MulAddUGenInternal(input, mul, add);
00144         internalUGens[i]->initValue(input.getValue(i) * mul.getValue(i) + add.getValue(i));
00145     }
00146 }
